rv.q: It’s also a fun time, and a worthy revival.
Some of the period costumes delivered by Alicia J. Austin could be better tailored and finished.
This is an entertaining play with meat on it and an utterly captivating production.

cn.t: Critics praise this Mint Theater revival of Hamilton's 1913 feminist comedy for its ahead-of-its-time themes and Lily Ganser's compelling lead performance, though some find it more historically intriguing than dramatically vital.
